headlines.title: Trump and Vance make announcement on fraud whistleblower program
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as President Trump and Vice President Vance make an announcement on a new program for rewarding fraud whistleblowers.

headlines.title: Former Cornell student alleging sexual assault addressed faculty senate in letter
headlines.description: A former Cornell student at the center of a sexual assault case that has rocked the campus says she felt unsupported by the university’s president, detailing her concerns in a letter to Cornell faculty. NBC News’ Danny Cevallos breaks down the legal and institutional fallout.

headlines.title: Christina Applegate says she was misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis
headlines.description: Christina Applegate announced Tuesday that she had been misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis.

headlines.title: Russia Batters Ukraine Amid Trump-Zelenskyy Standoff
headlines.description: Russia launched new attacks across Ukraine as the increasingly bitter standoff between President Donald Trump and President Volodymyr Zelenskyy heats up. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Spotify says it removed 50 million ‘slop’ and spam AI tracks this year
headlines.description: Spotify removed more than 50 million tracks created by AI so far this year, as it works to keep AI-generated music from crowding out human artists.

headlines.title: Jane Doe says Cornell president appeared to question her allegations in letter to faculty senate
headlines.description: Jane Doe, the woman who accused several Cornell University fraternity members of sexually assaulting her in 2024, sent a letter to the school’s faculty senate sharing a second-hand account of President Michael Kotlikoff’s response to her allegations ahead of a potential vote of no confidence in his administration.

headlines.title: Pennsylvania warns of rise in congenital measles and infection during pregnancy
headlines.description: The Pennsylvania Department of Health issued an alert Monday to doctors about an increase in measles infections in pregnant women, as well as a concerning rise in congenital measles — a disease that’s rarely, if ever, seen in the U.S.

headlines.title: Democrats jump into Mississippi Senate race
headlines.description: Senate Democrats’ top super PAC announced Tuesday it is launching a new ad campaign in the Mississippi Senate race, as Democrats seek inroads in Republican-leaning states to try to flip the Senate majority.

headlines.title: Top baby names heading into 2027 inspired by ‘The Odyssey,’ ‘Yellowstone’ and ‘Heated Rivalry’
headlines.description: BabyCenter released the most popular baby names of 2026 and the trends it expects to shape 2027, including “The Odyssey,” “Yellowstone” and “Heated Rivalry.”

headlines.title: Elderly couple pleads not guilty to murdering son-in-law, a NYT executive, at local park
headlines.description: The couple accused of killing their son-in-law, New York Times executive Jonathan McKinsey, pleaded not guilty to first-degree murder, a defense attorney said Monday.

headlines.title: ‘Call Her Daddy’ host Alex Cooper welcomes her first baby
headlines.description: Alex Cooper, the host of “Call Her Daddy,” is now a mom.

headlines.title: Oil prices rise, threatening to push cost of gas higher two weeks before midterms
headlines.description: Oil prices surged in early trading Tuesday, as energy markets adjusted to a new normal in the Middle East.
